title: SpyNetherPortals
description: Designed for SpyCore's worlds, nether and end dimension connection behavior
body:
# SpyNetherPortals
### (Join [Discord](https://discord.gg/fzcGYV7E9Q) for any issue/query/suggestion)

**SpyNetherPortals** is a specialized portal management plugin for **SpyCore**. It makes multi-world travel feel like vanilla Minecraft by intelligently linking Overworld, Nether, and End dimensions based on their names.

### 🔗 Automatic World Linking
No more manual configuration for every portal. SpyNetherPortals uses a simple naming convention to link worlds:
- `WorldName` (Overworld)
- `WorldName_nether` (Nether)
- `WorldName_the_end` (The End)

### ✨ Key Features
- **Coordinate Scaling**: Accurate 8:1 coordinate scaling for Nether travel across separate world files.
- **Safe Arrival**: Uses **SpyCore's** safe location algorithm to ensure players never spawn inside walls or over lava.
- **Portal Entry Control**: Prevents players from entering portals if the destination world isn't loaded or doesn't exist.
- **Bi-Directional Travel**: Smooth transitions between all three dimensions.

### 🛡️ Requirements & Compatibility
- **Dependency**: Requires [SpyCore](https://modrinth.com/plugin/spycore).
- **Loaders**: PaperMC (Recommended) & Spigot.
- **Version**: Minecraft 1.21.11.
